messages:
maria: quick heads-up — marketing is aiming to publish the release post + benchmark narrative tomorrow. need final changelog excerpt, canonical docs link, and rollout timing so we can bake CTA/webinar invite. any blockers? :wave:
jonathan: changelog is mostly done. i removed an internal debug line. public excerpt below, feel free to copy/paste.
jonathan: ```
- v1.8.0 (2026-03-24)
  - Streaming fallback for short sequences (reduces stalls)
  - Fix: KV cache eviction causing rare OOMs under burst load
  - Improved batching latency heuristics for GPU pools
```
sophia: docs live draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.8.0 — use the anchor /release-notes#v1-8-0 for the blog link. i've pushed a short how-it-works blurb for the batching change. review by 09:40 PT and i'll publish to prod.
alex: for rollout i suggest: canary at 10:00 PT (10% traffic, 30m), observe p95 < 50ms and errors < 0.5% then 50% at 10:45, full by 11:30. if metrics breach, auto-fallback to previous model variant.
sam: webinar CTA — we need a registration URL and a one-line benefit for the post: "see the new batching & cost improvements in action". also confirm which leads route to SF team vs inbound SDR queue.
lisa-marketing: registering webinar now. reg URL: https://events.redwood.ai/launch-2026. we'll set CTA as you suggested. lead routing: 1) enterprise signups -> sales-queue (SF reps), 2) SMB signups -> sdr-inbound. slack webhook to #leads-inbound is set; tagging rules: country + ARR estimate.
jonathan: for docs link in post use sophia's URL. changelog snippet above is good. one more ask: can you avoid the technical micro-bench numbers in the public blog — keep the narrative high-level and link to the benchmark notebook for engineers.
maria: yes — we'll link to the benchmark notebook for details (private link -> staged then public after 24h). copy for CTA: "Join our webinar to see lower latency and unit-cost wins."
sophia: published docs to staging and set anchor. final prod URL will be the same after 09:45 PT. i'll DM the prod link when live.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary window for "v1.8.0" at 1715553600 (10:00 PT). canary: 10% for 30m, auto-ramp options enabled.
alex: config snippet for canary (ops):
```
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  steps:
    - traffic: 10%
      duration: 30m
    - traffic: 50%
      duration: 45m
    - traffic: 100%
      duration: 0m
  abort_conditions:
    - metric: p95_latency
      threshold: 50ms
    - metric: error_rate
      threshold: 0.5%
```
maria: perfect. i'll schedule the post for 10:15 PT and the social windows at +5 and +30. web team — please wire the CTA to sophia's prod docs link when you get it. :thumbsup:
sam: routing confirmed. i'll update Salesforce mapping and notify SF reps in the morning.
lisa-marketing: final checklist: blog content + hero image ✔, CTA & reg URL ✔, docs link pending prod link from sophia ✔, rollout timing confirmed ✔.
jonathan: i'll monitor the rollout and be oncall during the window. ping me in this thread if anything spikes.
maria: awesome — thanks everyone. will post copy in #marketing-drafts for a last quick read at 09:50 PT. :rocket:
